description: This file defines the AssignNameExpression class, which extends NameExpression, within the Twig template engine. It manages the assignment of names within expression parsing, including deprecation warning for the class itself and validation to prevent assigning to reserved words.

classes.name: AssignNameExpression
classes.description: Represents an assignment of a name within Twig's expression parsing, handling deprecation warnings, reserved word validation, and compilation to PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the expression with a name and line number, triggers deprecation warning if called on base class, and throws syntax error if the name is a reserved word.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code that assigns the expression's name to the context array variable.
